title: Settings
description: Persistent user configuration stored in settings.json under %APPDATA%/perf-panel/

opacity.description: Window opacity level (0.1 = nearly transparent, 1.0 = fully opaque)

alwaysOnTop.description: Whether the panel stays on top of other windows

clickThrough.description: When true, mouse events pass through to windows beneath (Windows only)

x.description: Window X position in screen coordinates

y.description: Window Y position in screen coordinates

pollingIntervalMs.description: Hardware polling interval in milliseconds. Changing this restarts the helper process with new --interval-ms value.

visibleModules.description: List of visible metric modules on the panel

showTemperatures.description: Whether to display temperature readings alongside usage stats
